name: Advanced Connection Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Advanced Connection Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes ceiling fans in Thailand. The company offers ceiling fans under the Air-Le-Gance, Compass East, and Sunlight brands; and LED decoration lamp under the Lumos brand, as well as accessories. It is also involved in the property development and renting activities. In addition, the company invests in business of electricity production from solar power; operates a solar roof power plant; and engages in the financing and factoring business. The company was formerly known as Compass East Industry (Thailand) Public Company Limited and changed its name to Advanced Connection Corporation Public Company Limited in November 2015. Advanced Connection Corporation Public Company Limited was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
